usage.callShape: GET https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/defillama/prices/{coins} where {coins} is a DefiLlama coin id (e.g. coingecko:ethereum or {chain}:{tokenAddress}, comma-separated for multiple)
quirks: The {coins} path segment is NOT free-form — it must use DefiLlama coin-id syntax: 'coingecko:<id>' (e.g. coingecko:ethereum) or '<chain>:<tokenAddress>' (e.g. ethereum:0x...). The input/output schema in the registry is null, so this format is not documented there.
Multiple coins can be requested comma-separated in the same path segment; the response keys each by its coin id under body.coins.
x402 micropayment of $0.001 USDC on Base; pay-per-call, no API key.
usage.guide: Call GET https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/defillama/prices/{coins} where {coins} is a DefiLlama coin identifier such as coingecko:ethereum or chain:tokenAddress (comma-separate several in one request). It is x402-paid ($0.001 USDC on Base, no API key) and returns synchronously. Read the price from body.coins["<your-coin-id>"].price, with .symbol, .timestamp, and .confidence alongside it.
